subject: gk
question: Which of these conditions enhance the potential of MFIS to attract more resources and expand services to their clients ?

options.text: Financially viable and self - sustaining MFIs
Ability to disintegrate from communities they operate in
Ability to lend large amounts of loans

solution:
The correct answer is** Financially viable and self - sustaining MFIs.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Financial viability** and self-sustainability are crucial for MFIs (Microfinance Institutions) to grow and serve more clients effectively.
 
• Being **financially viable** allows MFIs to attract more resources, including investments and loans, which can be used to expand their services.
 
• MFIs that are self-sustaining can **reinvest their profits** into the business, enhancing their capacity to provide more and larger loans to clients.
 
• A focus on financial sustainability helps MFIs to reduce their dependence on external funding, such as **foreign aid**, making them more robust against financial crises.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
 

 Microfinance Concept
 Description
 
 
 
 

 **Microcredit**
 Small loans provided to individuals or groups in impoverished areas, aimed at spurring entrepreneurship.
 
 

 **Savings Products**
 Services that allow clients to save money safely, which can be crucial for financial stability and planning.
 
 

 **Insurance Products**
 Microinsurance products tailored to the needs of low-income populations, offering protection against specific risks.
 
 

 **Payment Services**
 Facilitation of transactions, including transfers and payments, to improve financial inclusion.
 
 

 **Financial Education**
 Training and education initiatives aimed at improving financial literacy among clients.
